scenes.title: The small-business gap
scenes.narration: Many teams need focused tools for tasks, stores, content planning, and repeatable workflows, but full-scale software can be expensive or unnecessarily complex.

scenes.title: A local-first tool workshop
scenes.narration: Zubair Smart Automation is an Arabic-oriented MVP that turns structured requests into small business utilities designed to run locally in the browser, with right-to-left interface support.

scenes.title: Practical tools, not just promises
scenes.narration: The current foundation includes a task manager, a mini storefront for products and orders, a short-video planner, a technical source catalog, and a workflow builder with explicit approval steps.

scenes.title: Privacy and control
scenes.narration: The browser-first approach keeps core interactions local. External AI is optional and routed through a separately configured server-side connector; API secrets are not placed in frontend code.

scenes.title: Business value
scenes.narration: For small businesses and operations teams, the concept offers a faster way to assemble focused workflows, test digital processes, and export supported tools as standalone HTML experiences without mandatory external runtime services.

scenes.title: MVP with a defined next step
scenes.narration: This is an evolving MVP, not a finished enterprise suite. Broader source auditing, production deployment validation, and advanced agent integrations remain open. Review the current capabilities and roadmap on GitHub.
